selection_rule: One default per role slot; overlaps become ranked alternatives or rejections. A native Claude Code feature that covers the slot is the default unless a measured gap exists. Repository quality selects (maintenance, releases, tests, docs, upstream adoption); popularity and invoke counts never do. A token or cost saving becomes a default only with quality parity measured on paired same-task runs (promptfoo 0.124.0 or the skill-creator benchmark, blind judge plus exact checks); otherwise it stays an alternative marked pending.

slots.notes: Adjudicated mixed: native default, with ccusage and agentsview ranked first among alternatives; the refuter upheld it. Owed: a fixed-window same-task reconciliation of native counters against ccusage. Scope verified: not covered are Actions under WIF (read the Console organisation's usage), ultrareview cloud runs (usage credits) and `--bare` workers; under the subscription `claude_code_cost_usage` is API-list-price value, not spend; the series carry effort, query_source, model, type and ecosystem_lane. Integrity preconditions: the prompt and response content gates stay off (OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES explicitly false); because the template sets OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1, the collector's tool-name and privacy allowlists are required; backends stay on loopback and no log or event export with values goes into the public repository.
